title: The density of θH^n⌞M equals θ at H^n-almost every point of the carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n (carrier M = R.carrier, multiplicity θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ). The properties of R used are: M is Borel (field measurableSet_carrier); θ is measurable (field measurable_mult) with θ ≥ 1 on M (field mult_pos); and for μHE[n]⌞M-a.e. x there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q (field orients). Suppose that μ_R := R.measure = θ·μHE[n]⌞M satisfies μ_R(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for μHE[n]-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P with x ∈ M, μ_R(B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) → θ(x) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n, and ρ^n is entered via ENNReal.ofReal. (No restriction on n.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ R.carrier → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞))
